BiblicalUsage: ʻulpeh is the word the Bible uses when it means mourning. In Ezekiel 31:15, In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻulpeh still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
